title: Prompt
description: The EDITABLE half of one agent's prompt (D42/D43): voice, craft guidance, structure. The contract half — output shape, hard rules, component menu, op vocabulary — lives in contracts/prompts/welded/ and is appended by code, never edited here. One file per prompt, at contracts/prompts/<role>/<name>.json.

role.description: must match the containing directory; decides the variable set and the welded block

video_type.description: advisory, like style_pack.video_type: narrows the picker, never read by the pipeline

description.description: one line, shown in the Prompts list

system.description: editable system half; {{variables}} and {{#optional}}blocks{{/optional}} per contracts/prompts/roles.json

user.description: editable user half; may be empty when the whole user turn is contract (chat)

model_hint.description: advisory model name; channel config still wins

max_tokens.description: overrides the agent's default budget when the prompt needs more room
